features: Uninterrupted Connectivity: The UPS acts as an inverter for your Wi-Fi router as it offers up to 3 hours of backup with its 2 x 2000mAh heavy duty EV grade cells, ensuring connectivity even without power.
Easy & Quick Installation: The UPS is a plug-n-play device and comes with an instruction for quick and easy installation.
Zero Lag: The UPS offers seamless streaming without any interference or lag, ensuring that you can stream with comfortably.
Safe & Hassle-Free: The device ensures safety from over current, short circuit, overcharging, discharging and high voltage for your ease of mind.
Compatibility: The UPS is compatible with all 12V routers. However, it is not compatible with UBIQCOM, Netlink, Syrotech, Alphion 100C, 1524, BDT-121, UT-STAR, ONT4842W, DBC, Digisol and AX Routers
Locally Made: This UPS is manufactured in India.
